LanguageData.HD_Settings_LimitToOnePlatoon_Desc: LOW raids field at most 40 people and HIGH raids at most 43. Excess raid budget is converted into support points.
LanguageData.HD_Settings_TacticalAI_Desc: Raiders use the squad tactical engine: stack-up room clearing, hand grenades, smoke, breaching charges and coordinated fire. It is unstable. When off, raiders use vanilla AI; engineers still breach doors and walls with sledgehammers and grenadiers still fire underbarrel grenade launchers, and raiders carry no hand grenades. Requires a restart.
LanguageData.HD_Settings_BodyVariants_Desc: Enables six adult Helod body variants. Only fitted clothing and body-independent armor, headgear and equipment can be worn. Changing this setting replaces adult Helods' clothing with a hoodie and trousers in the current game and when loading an existing save; removed garments are kept on the ground or in their inventory. Body variants are preserved when this setting is turned off. No restart is needed.
LanguageData.HD_Settings_UnifiedBallistics_Desc: Bullets with ballistic data are resolved against physical armour layers: plates, soft panels, helmet shells and shields, with impact angle, plate coverage, residual velocity and blunt trauma. When off, all damage uses the vanilla armour roll. Takes effect from the next hit. Always on while Lobos Arsenal is active.
LanguageData.HD_Settings_UnifiedBallistics_Locked: Unified armour and ballistics system: always on while Lobos Arsenal is active.
